items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: we eventually got Benny Carter to do arrangements for us... I knew Benny well... he asked me to arrange a (?) for him.

ctx.x: But let's get back to... Now, when you...
Right. So now, they got me in the band, and the first thing I started to doing was started getting them to write something. Then I think we eventually got Benny Carter to do arrangements for us...
